entries.RULES.admission.assembly: Members may propose to invite people to join the membership, and all members must agree 🏛️.
entries.RULES.admission.pen: Members may invite people to join the membership at will ✒️.
entries.RULES.admission.proposal: Members may propose to invite people to join the membership, and the membership decides ✏️.
entries.RULES.applications.apply:
ƒ (x) => (x.admissionPrice === 'pen' ? 'Anyone with the link joins on arrival.'
        : 'Anyone with the link may apply to become a member.')
entries.RULES.applications.invite: ƒ () => 'New members may only join by invitation.'
entries.RULES.authorship.public: Proposals may not be made anonymously.
entries.RULES.authorship.sealed: All proposals are made anonymously, and all names are revealed at the end.
entries.RULES.authorship.sealedElective: Proposals may be made anonymously, and all names are revealed at the end.
entries.RULES.chamber.closed:
ƒ (x) => (x.founderIsMember ? 'The document can only be seen by members.'
        : 'The document can only be seen by members and the Founder.')
entries.RULES.chamber.link: ƒ () => 'The document can be seen by anyone with the link.'
entries.RULES.chamber.public: ƒ () => 'The document is public — listed and readable by anyone.'
entries.RULES.judgments.after: Votes are revealed when the document is finished, and not before.
entries.RULES.removal.assembly: To remove a member, all members apart from them must agree 🏛️.
entries.RULES.removal.consent: To remove a member, all members must agree 🏛️.
entries.RULES.removal.proposal: To remove a member, a majority of members must agree ✏️.
entries.grammar.commit.bin: Clears your choice and closes — there is nothing here to put back
entries.grammar.commit.binLocked: Close — your vote stays on the record
entries.grammar.commit.cast: Recorded — choose again to change it
entries.grammar.commit.chillOff: Not this one, not now — it stays open and stops being the most urgent
entries.grammar.commit.chillOn: Cooled — this one will not be put at the front of your queue. Press again to allow it.
entries.grammar.commit.choose: Choose one of the three first
entries.grammar.draftFace.sealedLead: This is how your reason will reach everybody else: with your name off it
entries.grammar.draftFace.signed: This is how your reason will reach everybody else: with your name on it.
entries.grammar.fmt.mdMode: Markdown — see and type the characters exactly as they are stored
entries.grammar.ground.sub: the clause changed after you voted
entries.grammar.head.label: The clause as it stands
entries.grammar.head.nothing: Nothing stands here — the charter runs straight from Bringing a Guest to Guests Staying Over.
entries.grammar.lane.pickTitle: Say you prefer this proposal — nothing leaves the card until you submit
entries.grammar.proposeEdit.label: ✏️ propose edit
entries.grammar.proposeEdit.title: Write your own version of this proposal. Free to open — proposing costs one edit.
entries.grammar.revise.lockedTail: This one is settled, so your vote is on the record as it stands.
entries.grammar.revise.shiftedTail: You cannot change it, because it was not a vote about this text.
entries.grammar.speaker.sealed: A member wrote this. Who, is sealed until the closing record.
entries.session.blank.mayPropose: Nothing here yet — start typing to propose the first paragraph.
entries.session.chip.filedPile: ƒ (n) => n + ' decided and filed at this clause — open them'
entries.session.chip.gapSection: — a section proposed for this gap
entries.session.compose.allPlacesNote: ƒ (n) => 'All ' + n + ' places go in as one change'
entries.session.compose.rivalNote: Yours joins the proposals already racing here
entries.session.crown.accept: Accept — a Founder Action passes it now
entries.session.crown.foot: The membership passed this. Until you answer, the clause above stands.
entries.session.crown.refuse: Refuse — the Founder Veto holds it, and the clause above stands
entries.session.crown.waits: If it passes it goes to the Founder, who may assent or refuse before it lands.
entries.session.dead.deskLab: ✏️ propose something everyone can agree on
entries.session.dead.fieldLab: ƒ (n) => 'Everything in flight · ' + n + ' proposals, oldest first'
entries.session.dead.headLabel: The clause as it stands — and it is still standing
entries.session.diag.foot: This ranks the questions, never the answers — neither text changes either way.
entries.session.diag.question: Which of these deserves more of the membership’s attention?
entries.session.gap.atEnd: A new clause at the end
entries.session.gap.atStart: A new clause at the start
entries.session.nav.placeOf: ƒ (i, n) => ' · place ' + i + ' of ' + n
entries.session.patch.foot: ƒ (n) => 'One vote for all ' + n + ' places — choosing here chooses everywhere.'
entries.session.race.foot: Neither of these has to win — the clause above stands unless the leader clears the approval threshold.
entries.session.rail.deadlocked:
ƒ (judges, comparisons) => 'Deadlocked — ' + judges +
        ' people can’t agree on a proposal even after ' + comparisons +
        ' votes. Can you propose something everyone will agree on?'
entries.session.rail.noReason: no reason given yet — say what this is for
entries.session.rail.placesOf: ƒ (n, of) => n + ' of ' + of + ' places'
entries.session.rail.stillDeciding: still deciding — click to change your mind
entries.session.record.capped: the ranking maths stopped short on this one; the decision stands
entries.session.record.okTitle: It leaves your margin and stays in the record
entries.session.record.tooltip:
ƒ (judges, roster, floor, yoursLine) =>
        judges + ' of ' + roster + ' weighed in · quorum was ' + floor + ' · ' + yoursLine
entries.session.row.broke: No ✏️ left — another arrives as the drip accrues
entries.session.row.closeNothing: Close — there is nothing here to put back
entries.session.row.discardAll: Discard the whole draft — nothing has been spent on it
entries.session.row.discardDraft: Discard this draft — nothing has been spent on it yet
entries.session.row.editCost: — one edit leaves your wallet to pay for it
entries.session.row.idle: Nothing has changed yet — type in the document to start a draft
entries.session.row.penCost: — it passes at once and costs nothing
entries.session.row.placesChanged: ƒ (n) => (n === 1 ? '1 place changed' : n + ' places changed')
entries.session.row.submittedTitle: Proposed — one edit spent. It is in the race now.
entries.session.row.withdrawCost: — the edit comes back in full
entries.session.sign.anonExpLead: Nobody is told who proposed this
entries.session.sign.signedExp: Your name goes on it from the moment you propose it, and stays there.
entries.session.verdict.approve: approved (recorded as: proposal beats current text)
